d: Master Works is a Saudi technology company driving digital transformation through emerging technologies and innovative digital solutions. We empower organizations with expertise across data management, AI, software development, and digital strategy, contributing to the digital economy in line with Saudi Vision 2030.

Master Works is looking for a Project Manager, Senior to facilitate Agile delivery, lead Scrum ceremonies, and drive continuous improvement across development teams. The role focuses on sprint planning, performance monitoring, Agile coaching, and implementing Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) practices to enhance team collaboration and delivery effectiveness.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Certified Scrum Master certification is preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Scrum Master or in a similar role.
Knowledge of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) principles and practices.
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to facilitate team collaboration, coach team members, and drive continuous improvement.
r: Initiate and own Scrum events for participating squads.
Lead the efforts of developing Scaled Agile management best practices.
Facilitate daily Scrum meetings and regular ceremonies.
Plan upcoming sprints for a given project, including helping the team reach a consensus on what can be achieved during the sprint.
Monitor and report on sprints in progress.
Communicate closely with Delivery Managers for alignment and planning updates.
Collect and analyze related metrics for trends and indicators, facilitate iteration and increment planning, and provide Agile coaching and mentoring at all levels within the organization.
Work with the leadership team to strategically improve the efficiency and effectiveness of Agile processes.
Establish SAFe Agile principles and interface with other departments to ensure clear communication regarding ongoing and upcoming development activities.

d: Reso is a leading research organization in the Middle East. Based in Bahrain, we provide high-quality on-demand research tailored to our client’s needs.

Reso is an emerging global leader in research and analytics solutions that is continuously seeking to attract talented, motivated and intellectually curious research analysts to join our dynamic team.
Working with us provides many opportunities to grow and learn. Assignments vary across sectors and geographies, enabling team members to gain broad knowledge and exposure.

A typical day is demanding with multiple client deliverables and tight deadlines to meet. Individuals are expected to be diligent, resourceful and efficient. Work is highly collaborative and our team is friendly and supportive.
If you are a driven individual, with a passion to learn, we encourage you to apply.
The ideal candidate would have the following skills and characteristics:
A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree. We are open to any academic background including Business, Economics, Liberal Arts, Engineering, Sciences, etc.
Strong communication skills including the ability to design and develop well-structured written material
Excellent internet research skills including the ability to gather, synthesize and interpret large quantities of information from different sources
Proficiency in MS Office applications including Word, Excel and PowerPoint
Intellectually curious; eager to learn and explore new topics
Strong multi-tasking skills, high attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Committed to maintain high quality standards and meeting deadlines under pressure
To learn more about us, visit our website at resoinsights.com and our Instagram account @lifeatreso

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

The Sales Assistant role focuses on generating sales, delivering positive customer experiences, and performing operational tasks as directed by store management. The role is integral to maintaining store presentation standards and ensuring customer satisfaction.
q: Ability to engage and build rapport with customers.
Organizational skills to maintain cleanliness and store standards.
Physical stamina for standing and lifting as required.
What Qualifies You For The Role
Ability to stand for a minimum of 8 hours and perform some heavy lifting.

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.

We don’t just operate stores; we shape retail experiences. From launching brands like Watsons and Kiabi to our regions for the first time, to investing in digital innovation, AI capabilities, the customer experience and loyalty platforms, we are constantly redefining the future of retail.

With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.
Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.
r: Maintain store standards and cleanliness to ensure a clean and organized environment.
Create a positive first impression through an energetic attitude and adherence to the dress code.
Greet customers immediately upon entering the store with a smile and sincere greeting.
Provide customers with current and relevant information about the products.
Offer quality service in fitting rooms, follow up with customers timely, and maintain cash wrap cleanliness.
Provide efficient service at the cash wrap, offer gift cards, maintain cleanliness, and capture customer information.
Thank customers sincerely as they exit the store and invite them back.

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Senior Traffic Engineer & Modeler to join our team! In this role you will get to perform conventional and moderately to complex engineering assignments, applying engineering techniques and analyses within a discipline.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field from a recognized University.
Minimum 10+ years of in-depth experience with Traffic Impact Studies, Traffic Operational Analysis.
Experience on large scale master planning, mega / giga projects, and mixed-use developments.
Must have thorough working knowledge with traffic analysis tools such as SYNCHRO, VISUM, VISSIM, HCS, EMME and other traffic engineering & mobility modeling software.
Must have experience in parking management, parking demand and supply, parking design within buildings, traffic circulations, determining the number of accesses/egresses.
Must have experience on working with traffic diversion plans as per KSA standards.
Knowledge of KSA local standards and guidelines, including SHC, RCRC, RTGM, RCMC and other applicable guidelines and procedures for transport studies.
Must have excellent written and oral communications skills in English & Arabic.
Excellent report writing skills, preparation of presentations.
A strong understanding of transport modelling, demand forecast and multi-modal methodologies.
Master’s degree in transportation will be an added advantage.
Highly desirable to have experience in Public Transport, Travel Demand Management, and Intelligent Transportation Systems.
Experience with PTV Viswalk will be an added advantage.
Strong report writing skills and experience preparing technical presentations for clients and stakeholders.

r: As Senior Traffic Engineer, the applicant will develop traffic reports including traffic impact studies, traffic impact assessments, traffic survey report, methodology report etc.
Develop travel demand modeling using PTV VISUM, EMME and other software packages.
Perform traffic operational analysis for road network using software’s such as Sidra, Synchro, HCS and PTV VISSIM.
Conducting parking studies in terms of parking demand and supply, parking design within buildings, traffic circulation, determining the number of accesses/egresses.
Comprehensive knowledge of Highway Capacity Manual (HCM) and Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD) KSA.

Experienced in using micro mobility options, including bicycles, e-bicycles, and e-scooters, which offer convenient transportation for first and last mile connectivity, helping reduce congestion and improve quality of life.
Maintains first level quality assurance to confirm perform all work within his/her discipline in accordance with the traffic and transportation industry standards.
Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams to bring projects from concept to completion.
Supporting project managers and senior staff by participating in client meetings to discuss project requirements and deliverables, etc.
Working within established project teams to deliver planning, design and junction analysis tasks.
Liaises with RCRC, RCMC, Municipalities, MOT and other KSA local authorities’ officials.
Oversee the preparation and submission of project documentation to compliance with relevant local authorities.
Perform other related duties based on the requirements of the organization.
Leading the project and / or client / authority interactions.
